method: Every order the account really placed on MEXC is replayed on MEXC and on Kraken 5-minute candles with identical signal, levels, level changes, cancel and manual-close times. The fill and trigger rules are chosen by a calibration grid: the rules under which the MEXC replay best reproduces the REAL MEXC result. Kraken then runs under exactly those rules, so the Kraken-vs-MEXC-replay difference is the venue alone.

assumptions.kraken_fee_schedule: Pro/MTF lowest tier 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker (Consumer 0.25%/0.25% shown separately)
assumptions.after_tp1: stop to breakeven on the runner
assumptions.same_bar: a bar hitting stop and target resolves stop-first (pessimistic), counted
assumptions.netting: Kraken cannot hold long+short on one coin: the later opposite signal is skipped
assumptions.stop_slippage: MEXC none (calibration: walking its book overstated real cost); Kraken pays its EXTRA slippage over MEXC, from current order-book snapshots (median of 3) - neither venue publishes historical depth
assumptions.volume_fills: a bar can fill a resting limit only if it traded at least our notional
assumptions.kraken_triggers: mark price (the Kraken broker's setting); last-price result shown alongside
